subject: Closure sprint: security gates, DPA redline & retention clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@fintruity.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Closure sprint & SOC 2 evidence cadence

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to accelerate to a May/June close if possible. Before we lock dates I need to confirm a few items for our compliance team so we can finalize the mutual action plan (MAP):

- SOC 2: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report? If not, what is the timeline to provide SOC coverage evidence?
- SIG/CAIQ: Can you provide a completed CAIQ or an alternate SSP export that we can ingest?
- DPA: Our legal team will need to sign a data processing addendum. Any standard redline caveats?
- Data retention: We need clarity on per-customer retention windows, EU residency options, and secure deletion processes.

If you can outline the acceptance criteria for each gate (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA, retention) we can slot them into our internal procurement sprint.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we plan a procurement review on 2028-06-03.

Best,
Alex Turner
CTO, Fintruity
alex@fintruity.com

--
Attachment: Fintruity_Security_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@fintruity.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-21T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Closure sprint & SOC 2 evidence cadence

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we can close in June with a short, focused MAP and a few deliverables up-front. Proposed MAP milestones (high level):

1) Contract redline & DPA sign (target: 2028-05-31) — Laura to confirm any non-standard asks.
2) SIG/CAIQ exchange (target: 2028-05-24) — we can provide a completed CAIQ export + SSP snapshot.
3) SOC artefacts (target: 2028-06-07) — if you need the full Type II report we can provide the latest report under NDA; otherwise we can surface controls evidence for the key controls in-scope for your procurement reviewers.
4) Final acceptance (target: 2028-06-10) — evidence verified, DPA signed, deployment checklist complete.

Acceptance criteria (draft):
- DPA: signed or mutually agreed redline; no data localization carveouts beyond EU residency option.
- SIG/CAIQ: CAIQ exported and a follow-up 30-minute walkthrough of high-risk items.
- SOC: either full Type II report under NDA OR a controls evidence pack covering access, encryption, logging, incident response for the evaluated period.
- Retention: explicit retention window per data class, documented deletion flow, and option for EU resident processing if required.

Laura/Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm bankable targets for DPA turnaround and whether the EU residency option requires an extra addendum? Alex — I reviewed your attached security request; Laura will return a redline by EOD 2028-05-23 if possible.

If that timeline looks OK, I will assemble a short MAP doc and share links/next steps.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex@fintruity.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-23T11:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Closure sprint & SOC 2 evidence cadence — DPA redline

Team / Alex —

Attached is a redline of the standard Redwood DPA (Redlined_DPA_v2.pdf). High level notes:

- Data residency: we offer EU residency for customer data stored in our Private deployments; for Hosted we provide contractual assurances plus subprocessor controls. If Fintruity requires EU-only processing at close, we will need a simple annex and a brief operational runbook (we can produce both).
- Retention: default retention windows are 30/90/365 days mapped to ephemeral, session, and audit data; we can adopt 180-day retention for specific object classes on request. Deletion flows: documented workflow + audit log entry for deletion events.
- SOC 2: our latest Type II report is available under standard NDA. For procurement speed, we can provide a controls summary deck and targeted evidence for the controls you call out as must-haves.

I will circulate the redline (attached). If we need additional carveouts for data residency, please flag specific records/workloads.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: Redlined_DPA_v2.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Alex Turner <alex@fintruity.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintruity.com
Date: 2028-05-24T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Closure sprint & SOC 2 evidence cadence — quick clarifications

Laura / Rishi —

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the DPA. A few clarifications from our security team:

- We will accept the DPA annex for EU residency; we only need confirmation you can guarantee EU data-at-rest for designated customer data stores.
- On SOC: our procurement can take the controls summary but will request the full Type II prior to PO issuance — can you confirm NDA steps?
- KMS & key management: do you support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for Dedicated/Private? If not, please document encryption key lifecycle and HSM provider.

We uploaded the filled security request (attached) and flagged three items as "blocking" for procurement: KMS, incident notification SLA, and subprocessor list.

If possible, let's do a 30-minute risk walk-through on Monday (2028-05-27).

Regards,
Alex

--
Attachment: Fintruity_Security_Request.xlsx (updated)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@fintruity.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-27T16:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Closure sprint & SOC 2 evidence cadence — MAP & next steps

Alex —

Great sync window on Monday confirmed. Circling back with a concise MAP doc attached that captures the final-mile acceptance criteria and owners:

- DPA sign: owner Laura Bennett; target 2028-05-31; deliverable = signed DPA (Redlined_DPA_v2.pdf).
- SIG/CAIQ: owner Karthik Iyer; target 2028-05-24 (already delivered); deliverable = CAIQ export + 30-min walkthrough.
- SOC evidence: owner Marissa Cole; target 2028-06-07; deliverable = controls evidence pack OR Type II under NDA. Laura to coordinate NDA receipt.
- KMS/key mgmt: owner Karthik Iyer; deliverable = documentation of key lifecycle and HSM provider + options for BYOK in Dedicated/Private.
- Data retention & residency: owner Laura Bennett; deliverable = retention matrix and EU residency annex (if elected). Default retention: 30/90/365; custom retention to 180 for specified classes on request.
- Incident notification SLA: owner Marissa Cole; deliverable = written SLA excerpt (T+24 initial notification, full RCA within 10 business days for Sev1).

Acceptance for go/no-go: all deliverables above signed off by Fintruity procurement/security + DPA executed.

Next steps I will take now:
1) Upload MAP_Close_Sprint_20280527.pdf to the shared drive and post HubSpot milestone.
2) Laura sends DPA final redline back to Alex by 2028-05-23 EOD (completed).
3) Karthik provides KMS and subprocessor list by the Monday walkthrough.
4) Marissa prepares SOC evidence packet and NDA process steps.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FT-2028-0421 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPSprint

I'll be on the 05/27 call to run acceptance criteria. Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

--
